tasks.short: Operate, drive or explain recreational facilities mechanical equipment.

steps.what: Find and verify the current equipment operating instructions using native asset-linked manuals
Check the actual equipment and operate or drive it within authorised procedures
inputs: actual mechanical equipment and operating conditions

steps.what: Explain the equipment controls and demonstrate use while checking the learners understanding
Write and approve actual operation, explanation and any equipment issues in the equipment record
outputs: approved final actual equipment activity note

steps.what: Save the approved final equipment activity note
inputs: approved final actual equipment activity note

tasks.design: Configure a native manual link against each equipment record in {ASSET_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER. The manager verifies the correct instructions, operates the equipment and explains use personally. Actual activity recording follows the work; final approval precedes a separate same-system save with no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current manual for the exact equipment revision can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing asset system can link its equipment record to the approved manual.
tasks.still_hard: Physical operation and judging safe use and learner understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The manager responds to the actual machine, environment and person.
tasks.altitude: Human equipment operation with easier approved instruction retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset records can link existing equipment identifiers to approved manual documents.

assumptions: All shares are provisional for a mixed operation/explanation instance; operation-only and explanation-only instances need separate observed mixes. Credit only actual remaining manual retrieval after native features.

Equipment register and manual owner supply existing asset_id, model, revision and approved_manual_version. s1 retains actual identity and currency checks. Missing or conflicting identifiers require manual lookup. No new upstream data entry is assumed.

s4 retains full capture of actual asset_id, activity_time, operation_performed, explanation_given and observed_issue after the work. A planned demonstration is not completed instruction. Existing native record save earns no benefit.
No control command, maintenance clearance or safety certification is automated.
unknowns: Residual manual lookup after current asset links
research_questions: Are approved manuals already directly available at each equipment record or operating station?

incremental.description: Check equipment-to-manual links and approved revision changes

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final actual equipment activity note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only lookup changes: 15 times 30% = 4.5 hours less 1 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 2.25 minus 1 = 1.25. Physical, explanatory and save work stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human equipment operation and instruction beside approved manuals.
reach: Less finding time for current equipment instructions
skills_to_grow: Checking equipment identity and manual revision links
role.ambitious_version: The manager finds the correct approved instructions quickly and retains every physical operation and judgement of user understanding.

job.title: Entertainment and Recreation Managers, Except Gambling
